verdict.rationale: SumUp's own docs describe sandbox merchant accounts with test cards that simulate successful, failed and 3D Secure flows, plus a Virtual Solo reader for testing pairing and checkout before switching to a physical reader. This is a genuine separate sandbox environment, not just a dry-run mode. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server or Agent Toolkit can target sandbox accounts for AI-agent testing, explicit statement of isolation from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios, including different 3D Secure authentication flows.
Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later
